CREATE TABLE [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
( 
	[FILE_NAME] [nvarchar](100)  NULL,
	[Date] [nvarchar](30)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [nvarchar](30)  NULL,
	[Metrics] [nvarchar](30)  NULL,
	[Source] [float]  NULL,
	[Target] [float]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)
GO

alter table [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
alter column Source NUMERIC(25,5)

alter table [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
alter column Target  NUMERIC(25,5)
